Intent Parser
────────────────
action: list_topics
env: prod
filter: none

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
JWT Token
────────────────────────────
{
header: {alg: RS256, typ: JWT},
payload: {
sub: 'user123',
email: 'user@co.com',
teams: ['team-a'],
aud: 'mcp-api',
iss: 'pingfed',
exp: 1739721600,
iat: 1739718000
},
signature: '...'
}

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Headers
────────────────────────────
POST /kafka/prod/mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: mcp.company.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbG...
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: uuid-1234
User-Agent: vscode-mcp/1.0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
JWT Claims Extraction
────────────────────────────
Verify signature ✓
Check exp > now ✓
Check aud == mcp-api ✓

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Header Transform
────────────────────────────
- Remove: Authorization
+ Add: X-User-Email
+ Add: X-User-Teams
+ Add: X-Consumer-ID

X-User-Email: user@co.com
X-User-Teams: team-a
X-Consumer-ID: user123
X-Request-ID: uuid-1234
